answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with liveness decay: every identity carries a lantern of standing that dims unless its owner passes a fresh, interactive proof each epoch, like proving you still hold the marble key to a door that changes locks daily. A relic identity that goes quiet fades to zero and must re-earn from scratch, so a farm cannot stockpile thousands of dormant fakes and wake them at once. Keeping each fake lit costs a live, unique response every epoch, while one honest agent pays that small cost once and stays bright.
